note: Kilometres on the 20 x 20 km sheet, x east and y north; Bayview island near (6.0, 18.98). Main towns race their tracks (club layout for C and B, pro for A, S and E): one race per class on each layout, plus one more in the town's own class. Villages, the secret and the tours list their own races.

bayview.name: Bayview
bayview.what: Where it all starts: the island village, harbour and Pit Stop.

hillcrest.name: Hillcrest
hillcrest.what: The hill town, castle, valley and raceway, as built today (2.4 × 1.6 km). Home of the old Continental main line.

quarry.name: Quarry Hills
quarry.what: Gravel roads through working quarries in the Spine's northern foothills. The first rally parts are found here, and the Pine & Peak narrow gauge starts here.

vinelands.name: Vinelands
vinelands.what: Wine country on the road south: terraced hills, a hill climb and a vineyard loop.

saltmarsh.name: Saltmarsh
saltmarsh.what: Fishing village on the dunes. A beach sprint at low tide, and the harbourmaster's ladder of time trials.

bramble.name: Bramblewick
bramble.what: Farm village south-east of Hillcrest. A backyard tuner sells class C parts that aren't in Bayview, and the milk-float champion signs for your team once teams open, if you've beaten her down her lane.

kettle.name: Kettle Falls
kettle.what: A waterfall hill climb on the rainforest edge, and a junction on the Pine & Peak line.

cobble.name: Cobble Cove
cobble.what: A harbour village at the river mouth: a cobbled sprint along the quay, with a Coast Branch station.

orchard.name: Orchard End
orchard.what: Orchard village on the Spine's first slopes, where the Glasswater & Southern line ends. Its apple-cart racer joins if you win the Blossom Run.

harbour.name: Harbour Point
harbour.what: A fishing port where three railway companies meet, which makes it the first battleground. The Dive kit is found here. An S-class night race runs along the coast road.

highmoor.name: Highmoor
highmoor.what: Moorland crossroads in the lee of the Spine. A rally shed sells class B gravel parts.

millbrook.name: Millbrook
millbrook.what: Mill town on the river below the dam. Win the Harvest Cup and its champion joins you.

dunmore.name: Dunmore Junction
dunmore.what: A railway town and the headquarters of Glasswater & Southern. A race through the goods yard, and a signalman's daughter who drives faster than the expresses.

tollgate.name: Tollgate
tollgate.what: An old toll house on the Old Quarry Road: a mountain time trial over the pass, and a Pine & Peak halt.

summit.name: Summit Pass
summit.what: The pass over the Spine, with snow at the top. A class B climb, and an S-class downhill later on.

ridgeway.name: Ridgeway Circuit
ridgeway.what: A club circuit on the lake's west shore, the furthest class B trip from home.

coralkey.name: Coral Key
coralkey.what: An island city off the north-west coast, visible from Bayview from the start. The only way in is the Undersea Road: about 4 km along the sea floor. Inside: the Reef GP street circuit, a Pit Stop, and island-only paint and body kits.

lowtown.name: Lowtown
lowtown.what: The old valley town, drowned when the Glasswater dam was built. Drive down the dive ramp from My City: secret parts, a ghost racer who only appears at night, and the old town's lost trophy.

mycity.name: My City
mycity.what: The hub, built along the Glasswater dam: the professional league, teams, a harbour circuit on the lake, GP Park, the lake steamer and the dive ramp to Lowtown. Both Grand Tours start and finish here.

cinder.name: Cinder Flats
cinder.what: A salt flat at the edge of the dry country: a drag strip and top-speed runs.

portcity.name: Port City
portcity.what: The east-coast metropolis and home of Redline Express: pit-lane circuits, night street races, the container docks.

lantern.name: Cape Lantern
lantern.what: A lighthouse village at the end of Redline's Cape Spur, with a cliff-top coastal sprint.

lowmere.name: Lowmere
lowmere.what: A cold village on the south shore, where the lake steamer docks. When the shallows freeze it holds a time trial on the ice.

larchwood.name: Larchwood
larchwood.what: A logging village deep in the pines. Forest stages, and a veteran co-driver who joins once you hold all three stage records.

pinewood.name: Pinewood Coast
pinewood.what: Rainforest coast and forest gravel stages. The Pine & Peak railway's workshops are here.

fernhollow.name: Fernhollow
fernhollow.what: A tree-fern gorge on the west coast with a Pine & Peak halt. A gravel sprint, and a rally driver who only signs if you beat her in the wet.

icefall.name: Icefall Hut
icefall.what: A mountain hut at the end of the Pine & Peak line. An S-class glacier time trial, and class E ice parts once you have three podiums at class S races.

frostcrown.name: Frostcrown
frostcrown.what: Glacier country and frozen lakes, and the home of ice racing.

mirage.name: Mirage Wells
mirage.what: An oasis town in the dunes on Redline's East Express. A desert sprint across the salt pans, and a racer who only runs at midday.

redrock.name: Redrock Mesa
redrock.what: Red canyons and mesas: desert rally and the long high-speed straights.

copper.name: Copper Gulch
copper.what: An old mining town in the red canyons. It sells class S desert rally parts, and a canyon racer joins if you beat her through the gulch at night.

aurora.name: Aurora Raceway
aurora.what: The far-south circuit under the southern lights: ten class E races on its layouts, by day and by night, ending in the endurance race.

polar.name: Polar Post
polar.what: The last post before the southern sea. Its ice racer is the final recruit, and joins only after an endurance win at Aurora.

bayview.name: Bayview Grand Prix
bayview.note: The island, the causeway and the valley approach, with a pit lane on the quay.

hillcrest.name: Hillcrest Raceway GP
hillcrest.note: Extended through the valley and past the castle, with grandstands and a real pit straight. Duke Rolo's home track.

quarry.name: Quarry Sprint
quarry.note: A gravel loop through the workings.

quarry.name: Quarry Hills Stage
quarry.note: A full rally stage over the hills.

vinelands.name: Vinelands Hill Climb
vinelands.note: The whole terraced climb: closed roads and a timing tower.

harbour.name: Quayside Sprint
harbour.note: Round the fish market and the quay.

harbour.name: Coast Road GP
harbour.note: The closed coast road, raced at night, with a pit lane on the harbour.

summit.name: Summit Pass Downhill
summit.note: Top to bottom, from snow down to grass.

coralkey.name: Reef Street Circuit
coralkey.note: Island streets. You need the Dive kit to get here, so it opens at class B.

coralkey.name: Reef GP
coralkey.note: Harbour, seafront and the lighthouse hill.

mycity.name: Waterfront Circuit
mycity.note: Streets round the dam and the waterfront.

mycity.name: GP Park
mycity.note: The professional circuit: pit buildings, grandstands, and the league's home.

portcity.name: Port City Circuit
portcity.note: A floodlit pit-lane circuit through the docks.

redrock.name: Canyon Sprint
redrock.note: A short run down the canyon.

redrock.name: Redrock Desert Rally
redrock.note: From the mesa to the salt flat.

frostcrown.name: Frozen Lake Oval
frostcrown.note: Ice racing on the town lake.

frostcrown.name: Glacier Ice Circuit
frostcrown.note: A circuit on the glacier lake, with snow-bank run-off.

aurora.name: Aurora Club Circuit
aurora.note: Club days on the infield loop: a reason to make the long trip early.

aurora.name: Aurora Endurance
aurora.note: The whole ring, by day and by night: the build-up races, then the yearly Endurance against Duke Rolo.
